name: Website Implementation Quality Gates
hardRules: Figma Core DS is system authority; website cannot redefine tokens or component APIs.
componentKey identity is required when a Figma Core component is mapped.
No new Core Card solely for documentation composition; use container first.
Responsive/typography/screensize is deprecated for Agent use.
P0 or P1 DS compliance findings block merge.
Reference-based work cannot pass visual fidelity without comparable visual evidence.
A changed route must pass direct-load and client-navigation runtime checks.
